SourceBinding.producer: registered exact source read and trusted E; no client raw body
SourceBinding.checks: original/profile/identity/commit/currentness and source uniqueness; RMA is physical support only

RecordVersion.producer: validated client descriptive fields plus exact current SourceBinding
RecordVersion.checks: predecessor=current record; quantity/range relation, no original-source mutation

Decision.producer: server current record/policy and complete validated partition draft set
Decision.checks: exact source union, no gaps/overlaps, no VOID bucket, current basis

DecisionApprovalEvent.producer: trusted approver context, exact current decision and current authority
DecisionApprovalEvent.checks: approve/withdraw capability, separate Quality and technical authority, no historical rewrite

Correction.producer: server complete downstream graph and validated successor record
Correction.checks: closed forbidden; uncertain/committed downstream effects preserved and coordinated

ScrapBasis.producer: current exact SCRAP approval/source plus registered STOCK/NON_STOCK responsible object/requirement context or exact authoritative NA
ScrapBasis.checks: required NON_STOCK has real responsibleOwner/object/requirement full proof/current branch; no stock absence -> NA; basis is not actual movement/retirement/value

FeedbackDraft.producer: trusted source and server stable feedback identity with approved user content
FeedbackDraft.checks: source version/purpose/baseline exact; draft is not PLM accepted/merged/change

QualityChangeAssessment.producer: exact authorized PLM impact source and Quality-only assessment
QualityChangeAssessment.checks: full relevant snapshot membership; no Owner assessment substitution; current source or fenced

QualityUseApproval.producer: APPROVED: current exact technical grant/source and independent Quality approve; WITHDRAWN: exact stored local predecessor and current qa-ncr:deviation-quality-withdraw only, no external technical current prerequisite
QualityUseApproval.checks: action branch selected before reads/capability; WITHDRAWN inherits complete exact original scope/target/grant/purpose/validity, protects new local use despite technical expiry/unavailability; original Owner quota/actual preserved; no release

DeviationUseBinding.producer: future adopted exact PLM binding/usage originals plus complete existing Quality approval and pinned scope/serial mapping basis
DeviationUseBinding.checks: full identity/source/record/decision/approval/partition/grant/Quality ref/use/target/scope/purpose equality; identity digest derived, never replaces member comparison; exact complete serial mapping source and local quantity; original DEV U/H and Actual/Meter separate

ReworkDispatch.producer: server exact MES 9.2 fields; persistent X-Command-Id=commandId; current NCR work/cycle and approved L-to-M mapping
ReworkDispatch.checks: all five expected domains flat, external Ref3 exact, state admission-only; no invented dispatchToken; never rewrite accepted MES body

MainHeadEvidence.producer: same-transaction result and exact predecessor/head profile; no self ref/etag in body
MainHeadEvidence.checks: one current aggregate; never reserialize frozen v5 into v6 under same ref

AuthContextCapture.producer: trusted auth/authority/scope under lock before business facts
AuthContextCapture.checks: no result/head/future fact refs; no credentials; final-effect audit separately refers to this capture

MainResult.producer: exact committed local fact set and stable intent/business digest
MainResult.checks: resultId no self ref; no future head ref; operation/resultCode branch paired

ReworkIntent.producer: trusted QA preparation under exact approved decision/partition; server allocates stable work/cycle once
ReworkIntent.checks: UQ E+exact decision identity+partition; new approval/request/intent key cannot create another cycle; no MES command/MayExecute

ReworkScopeAuthorization.producer: controlled QA-NCR/MES-authorized mapping approval on an existing exact ReworkIntent; never browser self-proof
ReworkScopeAuthorization.checks: same intent/work/cycle/decision/range, authoritative exact L-to-M relation and units; no future command ref required; current/final recheck

WorkIdentity.producer: server PREPARE_REWORK stable identity allocation before ReworkIntent
WorkIdentity.checks: parent identity contains no future prepared fact/command/work detail/result/head ref; same UoW authorization slot

OriginalAnchor.producer: registered exact original source read and stable server anchor allocation before SourceBinding
OriginalAnchor.checks: original identity/profile/bytes/Owner time retained; source logical identity cannot be renamed by schema/purpose; no future SourceBinding/head/ref digest cycle

PreparedOwnerCommand.producer: server exact registered MES serializer/source/authority and existing stable work/cycle/intent/scope
PreparedOwnerCommand.checks: stable commandId=X-Command-Id; accepted MES body members unchanged; all semantic/body/typed fields compare; no future Work detail or dispatch fact FK; local prepared command not Owner COMMITTED

ReturnBasis.producer: current exact RETURN approval/source and real logistics receipt/destination plus registered STOCK/NON_STOCK context
ReturnBasis.checks: STOCK stockContext exactly physicalContext.stock; NON_STOCK stockContext null with exact required object/Owner proof/current; no commercial credit or Finance reversal

UseAsIsBasis.producer: current approved USE_AS_IS partition and exact original technical/quality allowed-use policy
UseAsIsBasis.checks: no required technical deviation; proof covers exact target/ranges/purpose; no WMS availability mutation; if technical deviation required use H50

InvalidationItem.producer: server complete dependency graph after successor record and Correction identities exist
InvalidationItem.checks: cause FK after Correction body; Correction lists item identities allocated earlier without digest cycle; complete set required

CoordinationRequired.producer: server complete affected graph; exact Owner resolution only through adopted adapter
CoordinationRequired.checks: exact cause branch: correction Id+Version both present and FK exact E/ncr/correction; or both null and exact withdrawal Evidence; complete item/cause finalizer and cold recovery; no future digest cycle or professional rollback

PostCloseReconciliation.producer: registered trusted read/observation authority on exact prior closed cut
PostCloseReconciliation.checks: independent append commit; no ordinary mutation/head increment/reopen; original closure and Owner facts preserved

FeedbackBinding.producer: future adopted exact PLM result/request identity and existing immutable Main FeedbackDraft; currently fenced
FeedbackBinding.checks: draft ref/key/local version and MAIN-FEEDBACK-SUBMISSION:6 digest all equal original command/query/result; PLM version separate; MERGED exact target; never current reachable Owner bind

MainClosedBasis.producer: named exact R8 protocol producer: NCR-R9-CLOSE-PRODUCER-AND-FE-MAP or NCR-R9-H30-PRODUCER-AND-FE-MAP
MainClosedBasis.checks: closed body and complete typed children equal; exact E/ncr/full key/source/profile; DAG and one registered commit; candidate profile disabled until adoption

MainCloseGuard.producer: named exact R8 protocol producer: NCR-R9-CLOSE-PRODUCER-AND-FE-MAP or NCR-R9-H30-PRODUCER-AND-FE-MAP
MainCloseGuard.checks: closed body and complete typed children equal; exact E/ncr/full key/source/profile; DAG and one registered commit; candidate profile disabled until adoption

MainCloseUse.producer: named exact R8 protocol producer: NCR-R9-CLOSE-PRODUCER-AND-FE-MAP or NCR-R9-H30-PRODUCER-AND-FE-MAP
MainCloseUse.checks: closed body and complete typed children equal; exact E/ncr/full key/source/profile; DAG and one registered commit; candidate profile disabled until adoption

ClosureReceipt.producer: named exact R8 protocol producer: NCR-R9-CLOSE-PRODUCER-AND-FE-MAP or NCR-R9-H30-PRODUCER-AND-FE-MAP
ClosureReceipt.checks: closed body and complete typed children equal; exact E/ncr/full key/source/profile; DAG and one registered commit; candidate profile disabled until adoption

H30DispositionBasis.producer: named exact R8 protocol producer: NCR-R9-CLOSE-PRODUCER-AND-FE-MAP or NCR-R9-H30-PRODUCER-AND-FE-MAP
H30DispositionBasis.checks: closed body and complete typed children equal; exact E/ncr/full key/source/profile; DAG and one registered commit; candidate profile disabled until adoption

H30Publication.producer: named exact R8 protocol producer: NCR-R9-CLOSE-PRODUCER-AND-FE-MAP or NCR-R9-H30-PRODUCER-AND-FE-MAP
H30Publication.checks: closed body and complete typed children equal; exact E/ncr/full key/source/profile; DAG and one registered commit; candidate profile disabled until adoption

SourceProjectionBasis.producer: three exact named source adapters and authoritative assignments; NCR-R9-INITIAL-SOURCE-PRODUCER-MAP
SourceProjectionBasis.checks: no original shape/profile rewrite; same UoW final source vector/whole coordinates; full identity/root source slot; original ref types preserved

H30FinalGuardEvidence.producer: Finance H30 real same UoW FinalRead + RecordH30ConsumerUse named candidate participant; source writer stays locked until Finance effect commit
H30FinalGuardEvidence.checks: exact accepted query/result/head/qualification/registration/name/ref/effect/uowId; no remote token; guard then existing Finance effect parent then complete use; all same single commit, no local value computation

H30ConsumerUse.producer: Finance H30 real same UoW FinalRead + RecordH30ConsumerUse named candidate participant; source writer stays locked until Finance effect commit
H30ConsumerUse.checks: exact accepted query/result/head/qualification/registration/name/ref/effect/uowId; no remote token; guard then existing Finance effect parent then complete use; all same single commit, no local value computation

H30PublicationControl.checks: full source portion/control snapshot/tuple/body/raw/qualified current authority; one commit, no quality or Finance effect; immutable history and exact prior generation

H30InputBinding.checks: full source portion/control snapshot/tuple/body/raw/qualified current authority; one commit, no quality or Finance effect; immutable history and exact prior generation

H30PreparationReceipt.checks: full source portion/control snapshot/tuple/body/raw/qualified current authority; one commit, no quality or Finance effect; immutable history and exact prior generation
